messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — High GPU paging and allocation failures on runtime-prod (us-west-2). Severity: P2. Affected pool: shared-inference-1. Error spike started ~13:02 UTC. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/gpu-paging

sre_oncall: oncall here, taking this. confirmed request error rate up and tail latencies skyrocketing. assigning roles: miriam - customer impact + support sync, ryan - logs/traces, alen - node telemetry and heap dumps, platform-ops - capacity adjustments.

miriam: Customer impact: embeddings and streaming endpoints seeing 502/503s. Top affected customers: partner-analytics (high), internal-smoke tests. CS alerted; waiting on exact request ids.

ryan: sharing traces and aggregated metrics: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/runtime/shared-inference-1?from=2026-03-17T13:00Z&to=2026-03-17T13:30Z
Logs (short): s3://redwood-logs/prod/runtime/2026-03-17/13/* (filtered for ERROR/oom/page-fault).

alen: quick telemetry snapshot from nodes (13:05 UTC):
```
GPU 0: used 15672MiB / 16160MiB, page_faults/sec: 420, fragmented_allocs: 124
GPU 1: used 15980MiB / 16160MiB, page_faults/sec: 510, fragmented_allocs: 213
Kernel ssl-batcher-3: avg_batch_size=48 -> spikes to 128 on tail requests
KVCache hit_ratio: 0.62 -> drops during spikes
```

alen: initial hypothesis: KV-cache fragmentation + occasional huge batches causing backend to attempt large contiguous allocations -> kernel-level device page walks -> OOM/paging. Also saw recent deploy earlier today touching batcher heuristics (rollout 12:50 UTC).

sre_oncall: mitigation plan (immediate):
- roll back batcher change in canary (done by platform-ops)
- temporarily reduce max_batch_size -> 32 on shared-inference-1 (alon action)
- enable host-swap for KV cache on 2 nodes to relieve GPU pressure (if supported)
- drain and restart the two hottest nodes to defragment allocations

platform-ops: rollback canary done at 13:12 UTC. Reduced max_batch_size to 32 at 13:14 UTC for pool. Starting host-swap on node ids: gnode-47, gnode-52. Scaling +1 GPU spare node into pool (hot standby) at 13:16 UTC.

ryan: adding timeline entries to incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/3076543210 (wip). Collected heap/gpu dumps: s3://redwood-dumps/prod/3076543210/{gnode-47,gnode-52}.tar.gz

miriam: CS update sent at 13:20 UTC: "We're investigating a transient GPU paging issue affecting request reliability; mitigations applied, we'll follow up with RCA." Customer impact reduced after 13:18 UTC per error-rate metric.

alen: post-mitigation telemetry (13:20-13:30 UTC): page_faults/sec down ~70%, avg_batch_size median 28, fragmentation counters decreasing. Still seeing occasional spike when batcher attempts to pack many short requests into a single large CUDA allocation.

sre_oncall: keep monitor for 30m. action items:
- ryan to run request-level timeline + trace sampling for the window 12:45-13:30 UTC and attach correlated request IDs. (ETA 1h)
- alen to run detailed per-process GPU allocation histogram and share script. (ETA 2h)
- platform-ops to produce a short postmortem section on why rollback was necessary and whether canary rollout gating missed this pattern. (ETA EOD)
- miriam to collect customer error samples and attach severity matrix. (ETA 3h)

ryan: posting initial correlated traces for a problematic request: trace_id=tr_0x7f3a9, span showing batcher combining 94 requests into one allocation -> cudaMalloc failed path -> fallback triggered and request got 503. Link: https://telemetry.redwood/traces/tr_0x7f3a9

alen: temp mitigation suggestion for longer-term: enforce per-request max_tokens cap before batcher pack, and add a soft cap on continuous batch allocation size (e.g., disallow packing >64k tokens equivalent). Also evaluate KVCache compaction heuristics; we can force a background compaction on low-load windows.

sre_oncall: agree. For RCA thread we should track: root cause hypothesis (batcher change + KV fragmentation), contributing factors (insufficient canary load diversity, lacking compaction), mitigations applied (rollback, max_batch_size, host-swap, restarts), customer impact timeline, and follow-ups.

platform-ops: note — memory allocator logs show repeated failed contiguous alloc attempts at ~13:03-13:06 UTC before major paging. Pasting snippet:
```
[13:03:12] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory trying size=48MB contiguous
[13:03:12] allocator: fragmented free segments: 312 total_free=1.8GB largest_contiguous=24MB
```

customer-support: customers notified; premium partners asked to open a ticket if they see regressions. No SLA credits recommended at the moment; will reassess after RCA.

ryan: attaching minimal repro check we ran against canary config (fails quickly when simulated short-requests storm):
```
# repro harness
for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -X POST https://canary.runtime/api/generate -d '{"input":"short"}' &
done
```
Recommendation: add load-profile gating to canary to surface packing behavior.

alen: saving collected data to incident doc. next steps: full RCA doc to include allocation histograms, batcher config diff from previous successful deploy, KV cache layout snapshot, and suggested code changes.

sre_oncall: closing live mitigation. We'll keep thread open for RCA artifacts. If error rates spike again -> page back in. :white_check_mark:
